summary: Frontend-only smoke test of (1) Doctor Consultation green/emerald theme and (2) AdminOrders P1 — status badges on each card, status banner in detail modal, calendar popover filter, dropdown filter regression. All requested functionality works end-to-end. 37 live orders in the preview DB covered Confirmed/Shipped/In Transit/Delivered statuses.

issues: The hamburger menu still styles the 'Doctor Consult ₹999' link with rose colors (bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 + bg-rose-600 ₹999 badge). The destination /doctor-consultation page is now fully green/emerald, so the rose entry-point feels inconsistent. Functional navigation works (rose link → green page). Decide whether to repaint the menu link to emerald for theme parity.

doctor_consultation.rose_pink_in_DOM_outside_page: Only present in shared header hamburger 'Doctor Consult ₹999' link — see design_issues.

admin_orders_badges.sample_in_transit_badge_class: bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 border-purple-200 (shipped + AWB resolves to in_transit)
admin_orders_badges.label_text_correct: Confirmed, In Transit, Delivered observed in live DOM

action_items: (OPTIONAL THEME PARITY) Repaint the 'Doctor Consult ₹999' link inside the hamburger nav (and any other shared-header place) from rose-50/rose-700/rose-600 to emerald-50/emerald-700/emerald-600 so the entry point matches the now-green page.
critical_code_review_comments: STATUS_CONFIG is clean — single source of truth for icon+color+label across badge/banner/dropdown. Good.
resolveStatus() correctly auto-promotes 'shipped + awb_number' → 'in_transit'. Confirmed live with CG446980.

AdminOrders.js is 1071 lines — borderline. STATUS_CONFIG / OrderStatusBadge / OrderStatusBanner could be extracted to /components/admin/OrderStatus.jsx to keep this file under 700 lines (long-term hygiene, not blocking).
Calendar popover uses a fixed-position invisible overlay (inset-0 z-30) for click-outside — works, but consider closing on Escape key for accessibility.

modifiersClassNames.hasOrders uses 'after:bg-emerald-500' Tailwind arbitrary — verified rendering in DOM (after-pseudo classes present on 4 day cells). Theme regression for the public site (homepage / brand banner) still loads images and styles correctly — no Tailwind purge collateral damage observed.
test_credentials: X-Admin-Token: celestaglow2024 (also used as admin login password). Set via localStorage.setItem('adminToken','celestaglow2024').
seed_data_creation: None. Used the existing 37 live orders in the preview DB (covered confirmed/shipped/in_transit/delivered statuses naturally).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Doctor Consult page = fully emerald/green now. Admin Orders: each card has data-testid='order-status-badge-<id>', modal has data-testid='order-detail-status-banner', toolbar has data-testid='open-calendar-btn' / 'orders-calendar-popover' / 'calendar-clear-btn'. resolveStatus auto-converts shipped+AWB → in_transit (purple). The only outstanding (non-blocking) item is whether to repaint the hamburger-menu 'Doctor Consult ₹999' link from rose to emerald for theme parity — functional, just visual inconsistency.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The only finding is a theme-parity inconsistency in the global hamburger menu (rose link → green page); not a defect, just a UX consistency suggestion.
